value.answer: Agent Plugins 1.0 is now available in VS Code, Copilot CLI, and the Copilot app, allowing plugins to be built once and used across all compatible agent clients. This open standard packages agent skills and MCP servers into one installable plugin that is independently governed. Existing GitHub Copilot plugins that don’t target Agent Plugins 1.0 remain supported without requiring migration.
